items.text: Mike Cargile says he is a small businessman. He says he has worked as a writer, director, producer, and marketing director, and served as an Army quartermaster officer. His campaign says he is a deacon at his church and co-founded the San Bernardino County Patriots and the Tri-County Sheriff's Forum.

items.text: Cargile says human life begins at conception, but he supports abortion exceptions for rape, incest, and the mother's life. He says he opposes withholding medical help for infants who survive an abortion. He proposes shrinking the size of the federal government. He says he stands against boys in girls' sports and promises to protect gas stoves, gasoline for cars, and food prices.

items.text: In 2022 he told Grid News that the United States is run by "a satanic cabal of human traffickers and pedophile predators" working toward a one-world order, and that he would "do everything within my power to oppose this." Los Angeles Magazine reported in 2020 that his social media included memes targeting Black people, immigrants, Muslims, and LGBTQ people, and that he used the QAnon hashtag #WWG1WGA.
